subject: Startups
title: ByteDance: The AI Content Machine
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: ByteDance: The AI Content Machine.

hook.text: ByteDance is the most valuable startup in history at $220+ billion. Most people know it only as 'the TikTok company.'

buildup.text: Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance in 2012. His insight: use AI to personalize content feeds instead of social graphs.

discovery.text: ByteDance's algorithm learns what you like fast. It doesn't need you to follow anyone. The AI curates everything.

twist.text: TikTok is just one app. ByteDance owns dozens of products across China and globally, all powered by the same AI engine.

climax.text: ByteDance generates over $80 billion in annual revenue. Its AI-first approach outpaced Facebook's social graph model.

punchline.text: The biggest unicorn bet on algorithms over friendships.

quiz.question: What was ByteDance's key technological insight?
options: Using AI to personalize feeds instead of social graphs
